card.name: Words just before intravenous or intubation
card.fires_on: Words that come right before intravenous, injection or intubation terms, such as slow, rapid, i (of intravenous), or following. Seen in injection dosing text, especially anesthesia and neuromuscular blocker labels.

modes.label: Speed word before IV
modes.description: Slow or rapid right before intravenous injection, bolus or sequence intubation.
modes.example: Midazolam should not be administered as a<< rapid>> intravenous dose.)

modes.label: Start of intravenous
modes.description: The first piece of the word intravenous or a route abbreviation, after a dose.

modes.label: Linking word in infusion text
modes.description: A small linking word or number before an infusion fluid or bolus description.
modes.example: an appropriate infusion solution such<< as>> Dextrose 5% Injection,
